name: bonzai
description: BonzAI v4.1.0 — local-first AI creation, inference mesh, agentic companies, companions, games, and optional digital ownership.

scripts.start: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && concurrently "vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts" "electron ."
scripts.build:vite: rm -rf .vite && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.make: npm run package && npx electron-installer-dmg out/BonzAI-darwin-arm64/BonzAI.app BonzAI --out=out/make --overwrite
scripts.make:x64: npm run build:vite && electron-packager . BonzAI --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out=out --overwrite --icon=src/assets/logo --ignore="^/(dist|bonzai|binaries|out|out-test|\.venv|venv|build)$" && npx electron-installer-dmg out/BonzAI-darwin-x64/BonzAI.app BonzAI --out=out/make --overwrite
